name: Upload Patient Report
description: Doctor selects one of their own attended patients, picks a completed appointment with that patient, then sees every service request (test order) for that visit and uploads the result file against one. A Diagnostic Report is created linking the file to the order.

intent_examples: Upload a test report for one of my patients
Upload lab results for my patient
Attach a report to a patient's test order
Upload diagnostic report for an appointment
Record test results for a patient I've seen
Add a PDF report to a patient's service request
when_to_use: Doctor wants to upload a result file (PDF, image) against a service request for a patient they attended
Doctor needs to attach a lab or imaging report to one of their own completed appointments' orders
Doctor wants to create a DiagnosticReport linked to a specific test order they raised
when_not_to_use: Patient is uploading their own report (use the patient medical records page instead)
Doctor wants to create a diagnostic report without uploading a file (use create_diagnostic_report instead)
Doctor wants to order a new test (use create_service_request instead)
An admin/staff member is uploading on behalf of any patient in the org (use the admin Upload Patient Report workflow instead)

introduction: I'll help you upload a report in 4 steps: select one of your patients, choose your completed appointment with them, select the test order and upload the file, then confirm to link it.

completion.message: Report uploaded successfully. A Diagnostic Report and a Document Reference have been created and linked to the test order.

workflow_steps.name: Resolve Practitioner
workflow_steps.description: Silently fetches the current doctor's Practitioner record to extract practitioner_id for use in subsequent steps.

workflow_steps.name: Select Patient
workflow_steps.description: Search the doctor's own attended-patient roster (derived from their appointments) and pick one.

context_resolvers.description: Loads every appointment for this practitioner (tenant-scoped) so the patient roster can be derived client-side.

workflow_steps.name: Select Appointment
workflow_steps.description: Select one of the doctor's own completed appointments with the selected patient. The encounter is resolved automatically — if no encounter exists for the selected appointment, the workflow stops.

encounter_id.error_message: No encounter found for this appointment. Please select an appointment that has an associated encounter before continuing.

context_resolvers.description: Load this doctor's completed appointments with the selected patient so they can pick one — scoped to both patient and practitioner, not the patient's full history with other doctors.

workflow_steps.name: Upload Report
workflow_steps.description: Select the test order (ServiceRequest) this report belongs to, then upload the result file. A Diagnostic Report is created on submit.

context_resolvers.description: Load service requests for the resolved encounter so the doctor can select which test order this report belongs to.

workflow_steps.name: Attach Document
workflow_steps.description: Links the uploaded file to the encounter and test order as a DocumentReference, so it also appears in the Documents tab — same as the two-resource write the doctor dashboard's upload dialog does in one click.
